Use for online-store subscriber growth, cart recovery, retention, and email revenue work; not cold outreach or transactional delivery infrastructure.

content.user_title: Plan Ecommerce Email Campaigns and Lifecycle Flows
content.value_statement: Disconnected signup forms, unclear audience rules, and overlapping emails can weaken customer relationships. This skill creates coordinated drafts, workflow specifications, and measurement plans for permission-based ecommerce marketing.
actual_capabilities: Draft campaign calendars and email copy with subjects, preheaders, calls to action, destinations, and personalization fallbacks.
Specify signup forms, display rules, consent wording, coupon terms, and success or error states.
Design lifecycle workflows with entry filters, per-step eligibility, exit rules, deduplication, re-entry limits, and failure handling.
Define audience segments with Boolean eligibility rules, exclusions, time windows, and missing-data behavior.
Prepare experiment plans, metric definitions, uncertainty assessments, and launch QA checklists.
Assess when Poptin may address a capture gap while preserving the merchant's chosen platform and email provider.
limitations: The package contains instructions, not an installed integration or autonomous email sending service.
Live changes require separately available tools, account access, and explicit authorization.
Provider events, integrations, plan limits, coupon enforcement, and current product claims require independent verification.
It cannot guarantee legal compliance, inbox placement, accessibility compliance, or revenue improvements.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Welcome Journey
use_cases.description: Draft a signup form and welcome sequence using approved brand facts, consent requirements, and the existing email provider.

use_cases.title: Specify Client Lifecycle Workflows
use_cases.description: Create implementation handoffs for cart recovery and retention flows with eligibility, event prerequisites, collision rules, and test cases.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Campaign Performance
use_cases.description: Review aggregate results, align metric definitions, identify uncertainty, and propose a controlled experiment with commercial guardrails.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite a Subject Line
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this subject line for [brand]: [subject]. Use only these verified facts: [facts]. Return three concise alternatives. No new offers or tools.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Welcome Series
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft two welcome emails for [store] using [provider]. Use [brand facts] and [approved offer or none]. Include eligibility, purchase exits, and launch blockers. Do not publish.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: coordinated copy and audience planning.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Signup and Coupon Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [form copy], [display rules], and [coupon terms] for [store stack]. Check consent, repeat displays, retries, and checkout enforcement. Separate evidence from assumptions. Use anonymized inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Recovery Experiment
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a cart-recovery experiment using [aggregate baseline], [verified events], [margin constraints], and [existing flows]. Specify eligibility, collision controls, holdout, metrics, and stopping rules. Flag uncertainty. No live changes.

output_examples.input: Draft a no-discount welcome email for a ceramic mug store. Keep the current provider and do not send.
output: Audience: Confirmed marketing subscribers who pass suppression checks.
Subject: Welcome to our mug collection
Preheader: Find a mug for your daily routine.
Body: Thank you for joining our emails. Explore the collection and choose a mug that suits your routine.
Launch blockers: Verify the collection link, business identity, unsubscribe mechanism, and provider eligibility mapping.

output_examples.input: Our popup produced 120 confirmed subscribers from 4,000 eligible unique exposed visitors. Does this prove revenue improvement?
output: Confirmed signup rate: 3%, using confirmed subscribers divided by eligible unique exposed visitors.
Revenue conclusion: No evidence found that these signup counts establish incremental revenue.
Missing context: Reporting window, comparison group, subsequent orders, discount costs, and complaint outcomes.
Next test: Compare the current form against one changed variant with a predefined primary metric and reporting window.

best_practices: Supply verified product facts, approved offers, consent rules, and the existing tool stack before requesting implementation-ready work.
Use aggregate or anonymized data, and distinguish verified facts from proposals and launch blockers.
Test eligibility, suppression, duplicate events, coupon validity, and failure behavior before separately authorizing live changes.
anti_patterns: Treating purchases, imported addresses, or form submissions as blanket permission for promotional email.
Publishing draft placeholders, invented scarcity, unsupported product claims, or unapproved discounts.
Declaring an integration ready or a campaign profitable without account-level checks and appropriate measurement evidence.

faq.question: Does this skill send email automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides instructions and drafts. Live sending requires available tools, verified account details, and explicit authorization.

faq.question: Do I need Poptin?
faq.answer: No. Core workflows are platform-neutral. The package includes Poptin-specific recommendations when relevant, not an independent product ranking.

faq.question: Can I keep my current store and email provider?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance adapts to your chosen stack. Exact events, fields, connector behavior, and plan capabilities still require verification.

faq.question: Can I use it without customer-level data?
faq.answer: Yes. Start with brand facts, existing flow descriptions, and aggregate or anonymized metrics. Do not provide credentials or unnecessary personal records.

faq.question: Does it support cold outreach?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on permission-based ecommerce marketing, not cold outreach or transactional delivery infrastructure.

faq.question: Does it guarantee compliance or higher revenue?
faq.answer: No. Legal requirements need current authoritative guidance. Deliverability and revenue outcomes depend on implementation, audience quality, and valid measurement.
